propositions: Replace per-criterion evidence fan-out with incremental criterion verdict banking at primary-run completion; bank entries keyed by deterministic criterion_id and stamped with ticket/material/tree provenance for successor validation.

Successor runs operate on unbanked remainder criteria in request-budget-pooled batches (capped by model class: standard <=8, frontier <=12) rather than per-criterion, with each run capable of recording provisional verdicts to the same bank.

Emit full-coverage verdicts (verified criteria from banked evidence, unverified as met=false placeholders) always when any verdicts are banked; on finalizer failure apply deterministic no-LLM fallback with certifiable=false, eliminating verdict-less outcomes.
Replace flat _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS=480 floor with criteria-scaled verify_step_floor(c)=clamp(8c,48,480), reducing wasted budget on small tickets and decreasing recovery frequency.
Normalize read_file tool memo by path: cache whole-file content once per run, serve all line ranges from cache, eliminating 77% re-read waste measured in multi-criterion verification.
Pool budget arithmetic: N=ceil(floor/2), global=multiplier*N, per-run allocation floor(pool_remaining/runs_remaining), batch-shrink re-planning when launch floor B>=2*batch_size unmet.
